inspection.method: All 226 captures were viewed as ten contact sheets on the same built site (artifact 685e31c2) at the previous commit; after the capture was repeated for this commit, two of the ten sheets were viewed again and matched.
findings: The opening checklist still reads 'Earn the first receipt'; the label comes from the game session and changing it changes the golden baseline, so it is carried.
Community Stats shows its 'taking a timeout' state in local captures because no community service runs beside the capture server.
A 'Scenario loaded' note stays on screen in the phone overview captures.
The one-year realism check took about 115 seconds locally against a 120-second wait in the capture script; the capture was completed with a longer wait that is not committed.
fixesApplied: Trade breakdown card follows the fairness score; trade values are rounded.
